data.name: Sumedh
data.gender_notes: Sumedh is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Sumedh is a Sanskrit name derived from the word sum meaning 'good' and dh meaning 'thought'. This name signifies being victorious over one's own thoughts, implying a strong and focused mind. The name Sumedh carries the meaning “Victorious over thought” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Sumedh usually hope their child will grow to embody victorious over thought and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.etymology: Sumedh belongs to the Sanskrit linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Victorious over thought.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Sumedh total 7, giving a life-path number of 7. Number 7 is linked with Ketu and with the qualities of reflection, wisdom and inner depth.
